description: A tall cylindrical tube with a red lid sits on the table, with a crumpled shirt lying to the right. The left hand slides in to steady the tube while the right hand lifts off the red lid, grabs the shirt, and stuffs it down into the open tube, pressing and tucking the fabric deeper as the left hand keeps the tube upright; then the right hand picks up the lid and snaps it back on before both hands release.
